tool_args.rationale: Fit the specified siphon base law plus its open local sqrt(u_now) branch using the five paid rows. The supplied guidance reports adequate identifiability and provides a warm-start rho near 0.70, so a new measurement is not warranted.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied subtree guidance identifies the sqrt(u_now) branch and states the five pilot rows identify the three parameters; buying a probe is unnecessary.
The specified law is a reduced snapshot readout at the provided H, with no temporal ambiguity indicated by the pilot signatures.
The authorized source note says this candidate fails when s_grad varies; observed s_grad spans a broad range.
The authorized relay is a present-snapshot alternative inconsistent with the supplied sink-modulated base-field and open sqrt-branch guidance.
